# Echo Pond

> Echo Pond is a 2,600 sq ft house and studio in Canton, Massachusetts, designed by Of Possible (Vincent Appel), built by NS Builders (Nick Schiffer), with landscape by Dialogue-Environment (Terry Fitzpatrick). Construction ran from September 2024 to February 2026. This site documents the house: an article, a page on how it is built, and films and photographs of construction.

Key facts, all stated on the site:

- A main house and a studio under one gable roof a little over 100 ft long, joined by an open breezeway, on about 11 acres of woods and wetland beside a kettle pond.
- Frost-protected shallow foundation; the polished structural slab is the finished first floor.
- Panelized wood frame, 2x10 exterior walls at 16 in. on center, pre-cut by Cape Cod Panel.
- Passive House-level envelope: Rockwool mineral wool inside and outside the sheathing, between Pro Clima Intello Plus and Pro Clima Adhero 3000 membranes, behind a vented cavity.
- Cladding on walls and roof: half-sheet shingles of Roseburg marine-grade plywood, coated on all six sides in pine tar from Sage Restoration.
- Andersen lift-slide units, 9 ft tall, across the first floor; Velux roof windows.
- ERV in the main house, Lunos in-wall heat recovery units in the studio, no radiant slab.
- Landscape: four custom native seed mixes from Ernst Conservation Seeds.

## Pages

- [Echo Pond (article)](https://echopond.org/): the site, the material, the space, the history of Glen Echo Pond and the landscape.
- [Build](https://echopond.org/build/): the wall assembly layer by layer, then site, foundation, frame, envelope, shingle, glass, interior materials, furnishings, systems and landscape, each with a specification table, the firms and the products.
- [Watch](https://echopond.org/watch/): NS Builders' construction episodes in build order, with photographs by Motif Media.

The house is a private residence. The site gives its location as Canton, Massachusetts, and no more.
